style.loanwords_text: Use natural Hangul phonetic loanwords for established technical vocabulary. Explicit terminology entries take priority: retain Latin script only for entries marked keep English, and preserve protected brand/product/protocol names verbatim. Intentional UI exceptions are specified in entry contexts.
writing_rules: Use formal, polite Korean throughout tutorials and technical pages; do not switch to informal address.
For first-use English glosses, put the English original after a Hangul technical rendering in parentheses. Do not repeat an already Latin-script term in English-English parentheses.
Never put English in square brackets inside a Markdown link label; use an ordinary label without a nested square-bracket gloss.
Preserve protected brand spellings and technical identifiers when they begin a sentence, even if their initial letter is lowercase.
Use native Korean number words only for idiomatic expressions and counters; keep technical quantities and protocol/version identifiers exact. Use a comma for thousands grouping.
Use single curly quotes ‘ ’ for quotations inside double curly quotes, inner thoughts, or highlighting key terms, following context.
Do not add full stops to native Korean abbreviations. Preserve the established spelling and punctuation of retained English abbreviations.

Write for ordinary Korean readers. Explain commitment, turnstile and finalizer briefly in plain Korean when needed, while preserving the exact technical meaning, protocol details and identifiers. Do not omit, simplify away or invent source content.
Use 거래정보 보호 구역 for the complete compound shielded pool or shielded pools; this takes priority over shielded → 거래정보 보호 and generic pool → 풀.

Use reviewed menu wording for matching page headings and link labels: Payment Processors → 결제 지원 서비스; Treasury → 공동 기금; Store → 상점; Visual Identity → 브랜드 디자인 사용 규칙; Zgo Payment Processor → Zgo 결제 서비스; MetaMask Snap (title) → MetaMask Snap — MetaMask 지갑에서 ZEC 사용; Transparent Exchange Addresses → 거래소 입금용 투명 주소. Preserve protected names verbatim in prose.
Do not add first-use English glosses to headings or menu labels. English originals in parentheses are for prose only, unless the source heading itself includes the parenthetical.

MANDATORY compound override: shielded pool = 거래정보 보호 구역, shielded pools = 거래정보 보호 구역. 거래정보 보호 풀 is NOT acceptable. Apply this in paragraphs, lists, tables, headings, captions and link labels. With the directional particle write 거래정보 보호 구역으로 (not 구역로).
